ai_summary: Central Bank of India has announced the internal promotion of Shri Partha Sarathi K Naidu to General Manager-Strategy, effective August 1, 2026, as a routine management change reported under SEBI regulations. This move elevates a highly experienced professional with 34 years in banking, including previous roles in strategy and regional leadership, suggesting a continued focus on leveraging internal talent for the bank's strategic direction. No red flags are apparent, indicating a smooth and positive leadership transition.
